title: Why Perplexity AI is the Google killer nobody expected

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Perplexity AI isn’t just a Google killer—it’s a paradigm shift with its open API and real-time reasoning. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Google’s closed ecosystem limits innovation. Perplexity’s open-source foundation lets developers build on it freely. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But Perplexity lacks the infrastructure and scale Google has, with billions of queries processed daily. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Perplexity’s real-time reasoning and support for 100+ languages outpace Google’s rigid, monolithic approach. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Perplexity is the future—open, fast, and truly global. (4 sec)
